title: Alcoholism
description: Craftable drinks that you can drink for some bad effects
body:
### ALCOHOL POISONING IS NOT FUN, DRINK RESPONSIBLY AND TO THE LAWS OF YOUR AREA.
Or in minecraft, with this mod.

This datapack adds five alcoholic drinks:
Beer, Vodka, Red and White Wine, and Apple Cider.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![BEER RECIPE - Two wheat, one wheat seed, one piece of sugar, and one water bottle.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c808974e2f84ac546bcafd9d4e0f92d010714ed2.png)
![VODKA RECIPE - Two potatoes, one wheat seed, one sugar, and one water bottle.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a048db91549ca5090b25f9ac68dafb913326d11.png)
![RED WINE RECIPE - Three sweet berries, one wheat seed, and a water bottle.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82d26d7efd7e75686648941fd94db33a5b11ee77.png)
![WHITE WINE RECIPE - Three glow berries, one wheat seed, one water bottle.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1de9158d6439a7b1482c022c2c0631bf1c7c3bfc.png)
![APPLE CIDER RECIPE - Three apples, one sugar, and one water bottle.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20aa0c01c5359813b8fb15ca035f676b861b6700.png)

</details>

Each drink has its own effects, along with increasing how drunk you are, as you get more drunk you get more effects.
